posts.zh:
dsh-turn-fold 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。工具调用按 Think 段自动分组折叠；回合结束后整回合收成一个大组头，显示耗时/token/tok/s/缓存命中率指标。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f0f8fc674dfced7cb1fe.html
posts.en:
dsh-turn-fold is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Automatically folds tool calls into Think-segment groups and collapses each finished turn into a single header showing duration, token, throughput, and cache-hit metrics.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f0f8fc674dfced7cb1fe.html
